assets.generationPrompt:
Use case: historical-scene
Asset type: Matkakirja city-guide detail; one complete NEW photorealistic landscape historical-legend illustration.
Primary request: Noantri origin LEGEND, year 1535, fishermen finding a small old cedar-wood Madonna and child statue in a wet fishing net on the brown Tiber. One single camera-shot-looking photograph-like scene, not an authentic photograph of the event.
Scene/backdrop: Early Renaissance Rome, with a very softly blurred distant riverbank and LOW medieval Trastevere houses with muted reddish roof tiles. The bank is LOW old rough stone meeting the water, with irregular natural earth and old stonework. It is not a tall engineered retaining wall. The scene's background is an illustrative geographic interpretation of the commission; the tradition places the original find at the river mouth.
Subject and physical action: EXACTLY TWO ordinary adult fishermen in a weathered wooden ROWBOAT. They wear simple undyed wool shirts, loose cloth trousers and plain wool hoods. Both men are turned away from the camera, showing only their BACKS and hooded rear heads, their faces completely invisible. They stand behind a physically raised wet rope fishing net in the boat's middle depth and hold its upper edges, lifting it out of the brown river water over the near boat side. The old small carved cedar-wood statue, roughly 40 cm tall, is CAUGHT IN and visibly supported by the net loops, upright near the CENTER of the picture. Its mother-and-child sculptural form is clearly recognizable with the child held in the woman's arms. Both are carved WOOD objects. Show wet dark wood grain, ordinary drips and small NATURAL reflections. Net threads wrap around and below the statue in a plausible physical way. Neither fisherman is a portrait or the primary subject.
Composition/framing: LANDSCAPE 3:2, native exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels. Camera just above boat gunwale height, almost water-level, around 6–7 metres from the boat, natural 35mm photograph perspective. Brown rippling river in foreground; complete visible near side of small wooden boat and wet net with CENTERED small statue; hooded fishermen stand BEHIND the net in middle distance, facing away. Boat, fishermen and sculpture share a coherent real scale. Low old bank and low reddish roof houses soft and unobtrusive in the far background.
Style/medium: photorealistic camera-shot appearance, realistic rope fibres, damp aged wood, coarse wool, brown river water. Warm soft natural MORNING light, subdued natural colours, gentle shadows, believable exposure. No HDR, no dramatic grading, no oversaturation, no illustration brushstrokes, no CGI or game-render appearance.
Constraints: entirely new generation from TEXT ONLY, no source-image pixels. Opaque RGB sRGB. NO text, letters, digits, signs, logos, watermark or frame anywhere. NO visible faces, recognizable real people, actors or named historical portraits. NO magic, glow, halo or saint's circle around the sculpture; NO shining supernatural rays. NO motors, motorboats, plastic, metal contemporary boat fittings, modern clothes or modern objects. NO tall nineteenth-century Lungotevere flood walls, no modern bridges, no modern riverfront railing, no modern architecture. No large modern riverside façades. Only LOW old rough stone bank. No combat, blood or violence.

viitteet.title: Madonna de’ Noantri 2026
viitteet.notes: Official text, accessed 7 October 2026: tradition dates origins to 1535; fishermen find cedar-wood Virgin statue after a storm at the Tiber MOUTH. This is a legend, not independently established discovery. No image pixels fetched or used.

observations: Märkä Madonna-lapsi-puupatsas nostetussa verkossa, kaksi kalastajaa selin, soutuvene ja Tiberin vesi; ei haloa tai nykytekniikkaa.
Kuvateksti kertoo Noantri-legendasta ja Trastevere-taustan tulkinnallisuudesta.
